purpose: Verify Student Admin can create a new club by providing club name, allowed category, coordinator, co-coordinator, Club Faculty Councillor, and description.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; valid student records for coordinator and co-coordinator exist; valid faculty record for Club Faculty Councillor exists.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation request with name='Robotics Club', category='Technical', coordinator='student_01', co_coordinator='student_02', faculty_councillor='faculty_01', description='Campus Robotics Club'.
expected_result: Club record is successfully created with status 'open' and all submitted fields accurately recorded.

purpose: Verify system validates selected coordinator and co-coordinator are valid students during club creation.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; coordinator and co-coordinator are active registered students in the student registry.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation with valid student IDs for coordinator and co-coordinator.
expected_result: Student leadership validation succeeds and club creation proceeds.

purpose: Verify club creation is rejected when coordinator or co-coordinator is not a valid student.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; 'non_student_user' is not a registered student (e.g., external or invalid user).
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation assigning 'non_student_user' as coordinator.
expected_result: System rejects club creation with validation error identifying invalid student assignment; no club is created.

purpose: Verify system validates selected Club Faculty Councillor is a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; 'faculty_01' is a verified faculty member in the faculty registry.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation with faculty_councillor='faculty_01'.
expected_result: Faculty councillor validation succeeds and club creation proceeds.

purpose: Verify club creation is rejected when selected Club Faculty Councillor is not a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; 'student_01' is a student, not a faculty member.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation with faculty_councillor='student_01'.
expected_result: System rejects club creation with validation error stating selected councillor is not a valid faculty member; no club is created.

purpose: Verify system accepts clubs created with category Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; valid student leaders and faculty councillor selected.
action_or_input: Student Admin creates clubs with category='Technical', category='Sports', and category='Cultural'.
expected_result: All three allowed category values are accepted and clubs are created.

purpose: Verify system rejects club creation with a category outside Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation with category='Academic'.
expected_result: System rejects club creation with validation error indicating category must be Technical, Sports, or Cultural; no club is created.

purpose: Verify newly created club is recorded in 'open' state pending Student Admin approval.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; valid creation data provided.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club creation for 'Music Club'.
expected_result: Club is saved with initial status exactly equal to 'open'.

purpose: Verify Student Admin can approve an open club and record it as confirmed.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated; a club exists with status 'open'.
action_or_input: Student Admin triggers approval action on the open club.
expected_result: Club status transitions from 'open' to 'confirmed'.

purpose: Verify authorized Club Head can replace club coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated as coordinator/co-coordinator of confirmed club; valid student records exist for new leaders.
action_or_input: Club Head submits leadership change request specifying new_coordinator='student_03' and new_co_coordinator='student_04'.
expected_result: Leadership change is accepted and club leadership references are updated.

purpose: Verify system validates replacement coordinator and co-coordinator users are valid students.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated; proposed replacement leaders are verified active students.
action_or_input: Club Head submits leadership update with valid student IDs.
expected_result: Student validation succeeds and leadership update is applied.

purpose: Verify leadership change is rejected when a proposed replacement leader is not a valid student.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated; 'invalid_person' is not a registered student.
action_or_input: Club Head submits leadership update specifying new_coordinator='invalid_person'.
expected_result: System rejects leadership change with validation error; current club leadership remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify system maintains only current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments after leadership change.
preconditions: Club has initial coordinator student_01 and co-coordinator student_02; leadership change succeeds with student_03 and student_04.
action_or_input: Inspect active club leadership assignments after update.
expected_result: Only student_03 and student_04 are active leaders; superseded leaders student_01 and student_02 no longer hold active coordinator/co-coordinator designations.

purpose: Verify Club Head can book a club session with configured venue, date, start time, end time, description, and optional poster.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; 'Hall-A' is a configured venue; no conflicting bookings exist.
action_or_input: Club Head books session: venue='Hall-A', date='2026-11-20', start_time='14:00', end_time='16:00', description='Intro Session', poster='poster.jpg'.
expected_result: Session is successfully created and confirmed with all booking details recorded.

purpose: Verify system accepts booking when start time strictly precedes end time.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; configured venue available.
action_or_input: Club Head submits booking with start_time='10:00' and end_time='11:00'.
expected_result: Time range validation passes and booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify system rejects booking when start time does not precede end time (start time equal to or after end time).
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; configured venue available.
action_or_input: Club Head submits booking with start_time='12:00' and end_time='11:00' (or start_time='12:00' and end_time='12:00').
expected_result: System rejects booking with validation error stating start time must precede end time.

purpose: Verify system permits session or event booking when no time overlap exists in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: Existing session booked in 'Hall-A' on '2026-11-20' from '10:00' to '12:00'.
action_or_input: Club Head submits booking in 'Hall-A' on '2026-11-20' from '14:00' to '16:00'.
expected_result: No conflict detected; booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify system prevents booking that overlaps any existing session or event in the same venue on the same date (cross-type conflict).
preconditions: Existing ClubSession booked in 'Hall-A' on '2026-11-20' from '14:00' to '16:00'.
action_or_input: Club Head submits a ClubEvent booking in 'Hall-A' on '2026-11-20' from '15:00' to '17:00'.
expected_result: System rejects booking with cross-type scheduling conflict error; overlapping booking is not stored.

purpose: Verify system notifies intended student recipients after a club session is successfully booked.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated; valid non-conflicting session booking submitted.
action_or_input: Complete successful session booking.
expected_result: Notification service is invoked with session details for intended student recipients.

purpose: Verify Club Head can book a club event with event details, Club Faculty Councillor, configured venue, date, times, poster, and description.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; 'Hall-B' is configured; faculty councillor assigned; no conflicts.
action_or_input: Club Head books event: name='Annual Fest Intro', faculty_councillor='faculty_01', venue='Hall-B', date='2026-11-25', start_time='09:00', end_time='13:00', poster='event.png', description='Orientation'.
expected_result: Event booking is accepted and stored with all details recorded.

purpose: Verify system notifies intended student recipients after an event is successfully booked.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated; valid event booking completed.
action_or_input: Complete successful event booking.
expected_result: Notification service is triggered with event details dispatched to intended student recipients.

purpose: Verify a student can apply for membership in a confirmed club and provide achievements or application description.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; target club exists with status 'confirmed'; student has not applied to this club.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application to the confirmed club with achievements='State level coding participant'.
expected_result: Membership application is successfully created and recorded with status 'open'.

purpose: Verify a student can maintain membership applications to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: Student has an active membership application with Club A.
action_or_input: Student submits a new membership application to Club B (different confirmed club).
expected_result: Application to Club B is accepted and recorded; existing application to Club A remains intact.

purpose: Verify system prevents a student from submitting a duplicate membership application to the same club.
preconditions: Student has an existing membership application with Club A.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit another membership application to Club A.
expected_result: System rejects application with duplicate error; no second application is recorded.

purpose: Verify newly submitted club-membership application is recorded with 'open' status.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; target club is confirmed.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application.
expected_result: Application record is persisted with status exactly equal to 'open'.

purpose: Verify Club Head can access pending membership applications for the applicable club.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for Club A; open membership applications exist for Club A and Club B.
action_or_input: Club Head requests pending membership applications.
expected_result: System returns only the pending ('open') applications belonging to Club A.

purpose: Verify applicable Club Head can approve an open membership application and optionally record remarks.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for Club A; open membership application exists for Club A.
action_or_input: Club Head submits approval for the application with remarks='Welcome to the club!'.
expected_result: Application approval succeeds; remarks are stored and application transitions to 'confirmed'.

purpose: Verify system changes an approved membership application from open to confirmed.
preconditions: Membership application exists with status 'open'.
action_or_input: Club Head executes approve action.
expected_result: Application status is updated from 'open' to 'confirmed'.

purpose: Verify Club Head can create a voting poll with title, description, expiration date, choices, and target groups (batch/branch).
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head creates poll: title='Club Mascot', description='Vote for mascot', expiry_date='2026-12-01', choices=['Falcon', 'Tiger'], target_batch='2024', target_branch='CSE'.
expected_result: Voting poll is created with choices and target audience criteria.

purpose: Verify system accepts voting poll creation with at least two choices.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits poll with choices=['Option A', 'Option B'].
expected_result: Poll creation succeeds as choice count is >= 2.

purpose: Verify system rejects voting poll creation with fewer than two choices.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits poll with choices=['Only Option'].
expected_result: System rejects poll creation with validation error stating at least two choices are required; no poll is created.

purpose: Verify system notifies students in selected target groups when voting poll is created.
preconditions: Club Head creates poll targeted at batch='2024', branch='CSE'.
action_or_input: Complete poll creation.
expected_result: Notification service is invoked targeting 2024 CSE students with poll notification.

purpose: Verify eligible targeted student can access active voting poll and its available choices.
preconditions: Student belongs to target batch/branch; poll is active and unexpired.
action_or_input: Student queries active poll details.
expected_result: Poll metadata and available voting choices are returned to the student.

purpose: Verify eligible targeted student can cast one choice in an active voting poll.
preconditions: Student is eligible; poll is active; student has not yet voted.
action_or_input: Student submits vote for choice 'Falcon'.
expected_result: Vote is accepted, recorded, and student is registered as having voted.

purpose: Verify system records accepted vote in poll tally.
preconditions: Active poll with choice tally=0; eligible student votes.
action_or_input: Eligible student casts vote for Option A.
expected_result: Tally for Option A increments by 1.

purpose: Verify system prevents more than one vote by the same student in the same poll.
preconditions: Student has already successfully voted in poll.
action_or_input: Same student attempts to cast a second vote in the same poll.
expected_result: System rejects second vote with error; poll tally remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify Club Head can submit a club budget request with amount, purpose, description, and supporting file.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits budget request: amount='5000.00', purpose='Hackathon prizes', description='Annual prize pool', supporting_file='budget_details.pdf'.
expected_result: Budget request is successfully submitted and stored.

purpose: Verify system rejects a club budget request whose amount is negative.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; supporting file provided.
action_or_input: Club Head submits budget request with amount='-100.00'.
expected_result: System rejects budget request with validation error stating amount cannot be negative.

purpose: Verify system rejects a club budget request whose required supporting file is missing.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; amount='2000.00'.
action_or_input: Club Head submits budget request without uploading supporting file.
expected_result: System rejects budget request with validation error stating supporting file is required.

purpose: Verify system stores submitted club budget request as open request for tracking without online approval/rejection lifecycle.
preconditions: Valid budget request submitted.
action_or_input: Inspect status and stored state of submitted budget request.
expected_result: Budget request is persisted with status 'open' for tracking; no approval or rejection actions are available.

purpose: Verify Club Head can submit a club event report containing club, student incharge, event name, event date/time, description, and report/details file.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated for confirmed club; event has completed.
action_or_input: Club Head submits report: incharge='student_01', event_name='Workshop 2026', event_datetime='2026-11-15 14:00', description='Report of workshop', report_file='report.pdf'.
expected_result: Event report is stored successfully in the club repository.

purpose: Verify system requires report/details file when a club event report is submitted.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated; valid text fields provided.
action_or_input: Club Head submits event report with report_file missing/omitted.
expected_result: System rejects event report submission with validation error requiring report/details file.

purpose: Verify system allows assigned Club Faculty Councillor to access and review submitted event reports for councillor's club.
preconditions: Faculty member is authenticated and is the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for Club A; Club A has submitted event reports.
action_or_input: Faculty councillor opens and reviews event reports for Club A.
expected_result: Report metadata and details file are displayed to the assigned councillor.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for creating a new club by Student Admin.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated; valid student and faculty records available.
action_or_input: Student Admin inputs name='Astronomy Club', description='Stargazing club', category='Science/Technical' (Technical), coordinator='student_01', co_coordinator='student_02', faculty_councillor='faculty_01'.
expected_result: Club created with status 'open', confirmation message returned.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where an invalid leader or faculty assignment is identified and allows correction without creating the club.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated; selected coordinator ID does not correspond to an active student.
action_or_input: Student Admin submits club form with invalid coordinator; system identifies invalid assignment; Student Admin corrects to valid student ID and resubmits.
expected_result: Invalid assignment is flagged without creating club; upon correction, club is successfully created with status 'open'.

purpose: Verify exception flow when required club data cannot be stored, club is not created, and system reports failure.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated; database storage error simulated or mandatory database constraint violated.
action_or_input: Student Admin attempts to submit club creation when storage fails.
expected_result: No partial or corrupted club record is created; system reports failure to Student Admin.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for booking a club session by Club Head without scheduling conflict.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club; configured venue available; valid time range; no overlapping bookings.
action_or_input: Club Head books session: venue='Studio-1', date='2026-11-22', start_time='16:00', end_time='18:00', description='Weekly Jam', poster='jam.png'.
expected_result: Session created, student recipients notified, booking confirmed.

purpose: Verify alternative flow when requested session slot overlaps an existing session or event, system rejects booking and prompts for another slot.
preconditions: An existing booking occupies 'Studio-1' on '2026-11-22' from '16:00' to '18:00'.
action_or_input: Club Head attempts booking for same venue/date from '17:00' to '19:00'.
expected_result: System rejects booking due to conflict and prompts actor to select a different slot; no booking is created.

purpose: Verify exception flow when venue is invalid, time range is invalid, or processing fails, no booking is recorded.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head attempts session booking with invalid time range (start_time='18:00', end_time='16:00') or unconfigured venue.
expected_result: System rejects submission; no successful booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for booking a club event by Club Head.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club; valid faculty councillor context; configured venue available; no conflicts.
action_or_input: Club Head books event: name='HackFusion', faculty_councillor='faculty_01', venue='Auditorium', date='2026-11-28', start_time='09:00', end_time='17:00', poster='hack.jpg', description='Hackathon'.
expected_result: Event created, student recipients notified, booking confirmed.

purpose: Verify alternative flow when requested event slot overlaps an existing session or event, system rejects booking and prompts for another slot.
preconditions: Existing session booked in 'Auditorium' on '2026-11-28' from '10:00' to '12:00'.
action_or_input: Club Head attempts event booking in 'Auditorium' on '2026-11-28' from '11:00' to '15:00'.
expected_result: System rejects booking due to cross-type venue conflict and asks actor to select another slot.

purpose: Verify exception flow when venue, faculty reference, or time range is invalid, no successful event booking is recorded.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits event booking with invalid faculty councillor reference ('non_existent_faculty').
expected_result: System rejects booking with validation error; no event booking is recorded.

purpose: Verify main success scenario where student applies for membership in a confirmed club.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; target club is confirmed; student has no existing application to this club.
action_or_input: Student selects confirmed club and submits application with description='Interested in robotics workshops'.
expected_result: System verifies no duplicate application exists, records application with status 'open', and confirms submission.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where student applies to another different club when applications to other clubs exist.
preconditions: Student has an active open application to Club A; Club B is a confirmed club.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application to Club B.
expected_result: Application to Club B is accepted and recorded with status 'open'; previous application to Club A remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify exception flow when duplicate same-club application is detected, duplicate is rejected and existing application is left unchanged.
preconditions: Student already has an application on record for Club A.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit another membership application for Club A.
expected_result: System detects duplicate, rejects submission, and leaves existing application state unchanged.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for approving a single pending club membership application by Club Head.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head for the club; an open membership application exists for the club.
action_or_input: Club Head selects open application, enters remarks='Accepted based on interview', and submits approval.
expected_result: Application status changes from 'open' to 'confirmed', remarks stored, approval confirmed.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where Club Head approves multiple selected pending applications in one interaction, each evaluated independently.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head; two open applications exist for the club.
action_or_input: Club Head selects both open applications and triggers batch approval.
expected_result: Both applications are evaluated and transition independently from 'open' to 'confirmed'.

purpose: Verify exception flow when application is no longer open or does not belong to actor's club, it is not changed.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of Club A; application belongs to Club B OR application is already confirmed.
action_or_input: Actor attempts to approve the application.
expected_result: System refuses approval; application remains unchanged in its prior state.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for creating a voting poll with choices, expiry, target audience, and notifications.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head enters title='T-shirt design', description='Choose club tee', expiry='2026-12-10', choices=['Design 1', 'Design 2'], target_batch='2023', target_branch='ECE'.
expected_result: Poll and choices created, students in target groups notified, poll creation confirmed.

purpose: Verify alternative flow where target branch selection represents all branches for a selected batch where configured.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head creates poll specifying target_batch='2024' and target_branch='ALL'.
expected_result: Poll is created and target audience is expanded to include all branches for batch 2024; notifications dispatched accordingly.

purpose: Verify exception flow when fewer than two choices are supplied or target information is invalid, poll is not created.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits poll with only 1 choice or invalid target batch.
expected_result: System rejects poll submission with validation error; no poll is created.

purpose: Verify main success scenario where eligible student views active poll and casts one vote.
preconditions: Student authenticated; poll is active/unexpired; student in target group; student has not yet voted.
action_or_input: Student selects Choice A and submits vote.
expected_result: System verifies eligibility, records vote, increments Choice A tally, marks student as voted, and confirms success.

purpose: Verify exception flow when student has already voted, is not eligible, or poll is not active, vote is rejected and tally unchanged.
preconditions: Student has already voted in this poll (or student is not in target group, or poll is expired).
action_or_input: Student attempts to cast a vote.
expected_result: System rejects the vote; poll tally remains unchanged; no duplicate vote recorded.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for replacing club coordinator and co-coordinator by Club Head.
preconditions: Actor is authorized Club Head; proposed leaders are valid students.
action_or_input: Club Head specifies new coordinator student_03 and new co-coordinator student_04.
expected_result: System validates leaders, updates club record, records new designations, removes superseded designations, confirms change.

purpose: Verify exception flow when proposed leader is invalid or actor is unauthorized, current leadership remains unchanged.
preconditions: Actor is not the Club Head (unauthorized) OR proposed new leader is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Actor attempts leadership change.
expected_result: System rejects request; existing coordinator and co-coordinator designations remain intact.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for submitting and retaining a club budget request for tracking.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits: purpose='Equipment purchase', amount='15000.00', supporting_file='quote.pdf', description='New badminton rackets'.
expected_result: System validates amount and file presence, stores request with status 'open' for tracking, confirms submission.

purpose: Verify exception flow when amount is negative or required file is missing, request is rejected and not stored.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits budget request with amount='-500.00' OR missing supporting file.
expected_result: System rejects request with validation error; request is not stored.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for submitting documented club event report by Club Head.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club; event has occurred.
action_or_input: Club Head submits: student_incharge='student_01', event_name='Coding Contest', datetime='2026-11-10 18:00', description='Over 50 participants', report_file='event_summary.pdf'.
expected_result: System validates fields and file, stores report in repository, confirms submission.

purpose: Verify exception flow when required report file or required references are missing/invalid, report is not accepted.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club.
action_or_input: Club Head submits event report with missing report_file.
expected_result: System rejects submission; no incomplete report is accepted or saved.

purpose: Verify main success scenario for approving an open club by Student Admin.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated; club exists with status 'open'.
action_or_input: Student Admin opens club record, reviews info, and executes approve action.
expected_result: System changes club status from 'open' to 'confirmed', confirms approval.

purpose: Verify exception flow when club is not open or cannot be updated, no approval transition occurs.
preconditions: Club already has status 'confirmed' (not open) OR requester is not Student Admin.
action_or_input: User attempts approval action on the club.
expected_result: System rejects approval transition; club retains its prior status.

purpose: Verify main success scenario where assigned Club Faculty Councillor accesses and reviews submitted reports for assigned club.
preconditions: Faculty user authenticated; user is assigned Club Faculty Councillor for Club A; submitted report exists.
action_or_input: Faculty Councillor opens club report area, selects report.
expected_result: System displays report metadata and makes submitted report/details file available for review.

purpose: Verify exception flow when faculty user is not assigned to the club, system denies access to club's reports.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated but is NOT the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for Club A.
action_or_input: Faculty user attempts to access submitted reports for Club A.
expected_result: System denies access with authorization error; report content is not exposed.

purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-001 when coordinator, co-coordinator, and replacement leaders reference valid students.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-001 when coordinator or co-coordinator is not a valid student.

purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-002 when Club Faculty Councillor references a valid faculty member.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-002 when Club Faculty Councillor is invalid.

action_or_input: Submit club creation or event booking with invalid faculty councillor reference.

purpose: Verify permitted outcome of BR-GYM-003 when club category is Technical, Sports, or Cultural.

expected_result: System accepts allowed category value.

purpose: Verify prohibited outcome of BR-GYM-003 when club category is outside allowed values.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-004 outcome where new club creation results in 'open' status.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-004 outcome where Student Admin approval changes open club to confirmed.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-007 permitted outcome allowing student membership application to a confirmed club.
preconditions: Club exists with status='confirmed'.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-007 prohibited outcome rejecting membership application to an unconfirmed (open) club.
preconditions: Club exists with status='open'.
action_or_input: Student attempts to apply for membership in the open club.
expected_result: System rejects application with error indicating club must be confirmed.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-008 permitted outcome allowing a student to apply to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: Student already holds an application/membership in Club A.
action_or_input: Student submits membership application to Club B (different club).
expected_result: Application is not blocked by existence of application in Club A; submission succeeds.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-009 prohibited outcome rejecting duplicate membership application to the same club.

expected_result: System rejects duplicate application; existing membership state remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-010 permitted outcome authorizing applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator for Club Head operations.

purpose: Verify BR-GYM-010 prohibited outcome refusing Club Head operations when user is not coordinator/co-coordinator of that club.

purpose: Verify Transition 1 success path in BW-GYM-01: No Membership Application -> Membership Application Open.
preconditions: Student has no application for confirmed club.
action_or_input: Student invokes UC-GYM-004 (Apply for Club Membership) with valid details.
expected_result: Application transitions from 'No Membership Application' to 'Membership Application Open'.

purpose: Verify Transition 1 guard failure path in BW-GYM-01: target club is unconfirmed or duplicate application exists.
preconditions: Target club is in status 'open' (unconfirmed) OR student already has application for club.
action_or_input: Student invokes UC-GYM-004.
expected_result: Guard fails; application is rejected and system remains in 'No Membership Application' state for that club.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 success path in BW-GYM-01: Membership Application Open -> Membership Confirmed.
preconditions: Application in 'Membership Application Open'; Club Head authenticated.
action_or_input: Club Head invokes UC-GYM-005 (Approve Club Membership) on open application.
expected_result: Application transitions from 'Membership Application Open' to 'Membership Confirmed'.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 guard failure path in BW-GYM-01: actor is not applicable Club Head or application is not open.
preconditions: Requester is not coordinator/co-coordinator for club OR application is already confirmed.
action_or_input: Requester invokes UC-GYM-005.
expected_result: Guard fails; approval rejected and application remains in its prior state ('Membership Application Open').

purpose: Verify complete end-to-end success path for BW-GYM-01 from no application to confirmed membership.
preconditions: Confirmed club exists; student has no prior application; applicable Club Head available.
action_or_input: Student executes UC-GYM-004 (Apply) -> Club Head executes UC-GYM-005 (Approve).
expected_result: Lifecycle moves: No Application -> Application Open -> Membership Confirmed.

purpose: Verify Transition 1 success path in BW-GYM-02: Poll Not Available -> Poll Open / Target Audience Defined / Student Not Yet Voted.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club; poll does not exist.
action_or_input: Club Head invokes UC-GYM-006 (Create Voting Poll) with >= 2 choices and target batch/branch.
expected_result: Poll created; state becomes 'Poll Open / Target Audience Defined / Student Not Yet Voted'; notification dispatched.

purpose: Verify Transition 1 guard failure path in BW-GYM-02: actor not Club Head or fewer than 2 choices.
preconditions: Requester is unauthorized OR poll data has only 1 choice.
action_or_input: Requester invokes UC-GYM-006.
expected_result: Guard fails; poll creation rejected; remains in 'Poll Not Available'.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 success path in BW-GYM-02: Student Not Yet Voted -> Student Vote Recorded.
preconditions: Poll is open and unexpired; student is in target audience and has not yet voted.
action_or_input: Student invokes UC-GYM-007 (Vote in Poll) and selects valid choice.
expected_result: Vote accepted; tally updated; state becomes 'Poll Open / Target Audience Defined / Student Vote Recorded'.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 guard failure path in BW-GYM-02: poll expired, student not in target group, or duplicate vote.
preconditions: Poll is expired OR student outside target group OR student already voted.
action_or_input: Student invokes UC-GYM-007.
expected_result: Guard fails; vote rejected; tally unchanged; remains in 'Student Not Yet Voted' (or rejected for ineligible/duplicate).

purpose: Verify complete end-to-end success path for BW-GYM-02 from poll creation to recorded vote.
preconditions: Club Head and eligible student in target group ready.
action_or_input: Club Head creates poll (UC-GYM-006) -> eligible student casts vote (UC-GYM-007).
expected_result: Workflow progresses: Poll Not Available -> Poll Open (Not Yet Voted) -> Poll Open (Student Vote Recorded).

purpose: Verify Transition 1 success path in BW-GYM-03: Club Not Created -> Club Open.

expected_result: Club created; state transitions from 'Club Not Created' to 'Club Open'.

purpose: Verify Transition 1 guard failure path in BW-GYM-03: invalid student leaders, invalid faculty, or invalid category.
preconditions: Coordinator not valid student OR faculty councillor not valid faculty OR category not allowed.
action_or_input: Student Admin invokes UC-GYM-001 with invalid parameter.
expected_result: Guard fails; club creation rejected; remains in 'Club Not Created'.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 success path in BW-GYM-03: Club Open -> Club Confirmed.
preconditions: Club exists with status 'open'; Student Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Student Admin invokes UC-GYM-011 (Approve Club).
expected_result: Club status transitions from 'Club Open' to 'Club Confirmed'.

purpose: Verify Transition 2 guard failure path in BW-GYM-03: actor is not Student Admin or club is already confirmed.
preconditions: Requester is not Student Admin OR club is already confirmed.
action_or_input: Requester invokes UC-GYM-011.
expected_result: Guard fails; approval rejected; club status remains unchanged ('Club Open').

purpose: Verify complete end-to-end success path for BW-GYM-03 from no club to confirmed club.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated; valid leaders and faculty councillor available.
action_or_input: Student Admin executes UC-GYM-001 (Create) -> Student Admin executes UC-GYM-011 (Approve).
expected_result: Workflow progresses: Club Not Created -> Club Open -> Club Confirmed.
